text:
The heart is the organ that pumps blood.

In the quiet rhythm of the chest, the heart beats a steady, primal drum that mirrors the melody haunting the town’s memory. Just as the lullaby wove through the disparate lives of the citizens—appearing in street whistles and distant chimes to bind their shared past—the heart’s relentless pumping weaves life through the silent, invisible threads of the veins. It is the physical echo of that song, a rhythmic pulse that reminds every living soul that they are part of a single, breathing community, connected by the same vital flow that once brought peace, and now sustains the fragile harmony of their existence.
